title: Policy guideline chunk
description: One retrievable chunk from the policy / guidelines corpus (PIM, OIG, CERT, LCD, MedPAC, statutes). Consumed by fraudlib.pipeline.policy_search.PolicyIndex and produced by fraudlib.ingest.normalize. See docs/POLICY_SOURCES.md for per-source details.

doc_id.description: Stable identifier unique within the corpus. For multi-chunk docs the suffix _NNNN disambiguates (see fraudlib.ingest.normalize.chunks_to_records).

source.description: Origin catalog. Filters route agent queries to the right subset.

title.description: Document-level title (chapter name, Work Plan item title, statute name, LCD title, etc.).

section.description: Subsection label within the document (e.g., '3.2.1 Medical Review', 'Findings', '<window-2>').

text.description: The chunk body. Whitespace is normalized on ingest.

url.description: Source URL. Empty string allowed only when the source is a local PDF with no canonical online copy.

effective_date.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Empty string if not applicable or unknown. LCDs, statutes, and Work Plan items should always carry one.

fetch_date.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd when the source was fetched.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the normalized text. Used by the manifest auditor to detect silent updates.

applies_to_specialties.description: Specialties this guideline is scoped to. Empty when source-wide (e.g., a statute). Matched case-insensitive substring by the retrieval filter.

applies_to_codes.description: HCPCS or other billing codes referenced by the guideline. Empty when not code-scoped.

extra.description: Free-form source-specific metadata. Examples: LCD MAC list, OIG audit-report category, Advisory Opinion parties.
